import pytest
from store.cart import Cart, Item
from store.coupons import CouponError
from store import Receipt, ReceiptLine


def test_issue_empty_cart():
    """An empty cart gives a receipt with no lines and every total 0."""
    cart = Cart()
    receipt = cart.receipt()
    assert receipt.lines == []  # no items so no lines
    assert receipt.subtotal_cents == 0  # empty sum is 0
    assert receipt.discount_cents == 0  # no coupon so 0
    assert receipt.shipping_cents == 0  # empty cart has no shipping
    assert receipt.tax_cents == 0  # 0 * 8% is 0
    assert receipt.total_cents == 0  # 0 - 0 + 0 + 0 = 0


def test_issue_gross_qty():
    """gross_cents is price_cents times qty and net is gross minus discount."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="A", name="Apple", price_cents=250, qty=3))
    receipt = cart.receipt()
    line = receipt.lines[0]
    assert line.gross_cents == 750  # 250*3 = 750
    assert line.discount_cents == 0  # no coupon so 0
    assert line.net_cents == 750  # 750 - 0 = 750
    assert line.qty == 3  # as added
    assert line.sku == "A"  # as added


def test_issue_example_discounts():
    """Cart discount splits across lines in proportion to gross with largest-remainder leftover."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="A", name="A", price_cents=1000, qty=1))
    cart.add(Item(sku="B", name="B", price_cents=2000, qty=1))
    cart.add(Item(sku="C", name="C", price_cents=3005, qty=1))
    cart.apply_coupon("SAVE10")
    receipt = cart.receipt()
    # subtotal 1000+2000+3005 = 6005; discount 6005*10//100 = 600
    # floors: 600*1000//6005=99 rem5505, 600*2000//6005=199 rem5005, 600*3005//6005=300 rem1500
    # floors sum 99+199+300=598 leftover 2 to rems 5505,5005
    assert [ln.discount_cents for ln in receipt.lines] == [100, 200, 300]  # 99+1, 199+1, 300
    assert sum(ln.discount_cents for ln in receipt.lines) == 600  # equals 6005*10//100 = 600


def test_issue_example_taxes():
    """Lines of 1000,2000,3005 with SAVE10 give line taxes 72,144,216 and total 5837."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="A", name="A", price_cents=1000, qty=1))
    cart.add(Item(sku="B", name="B", price_cents=2000, qty=1))
    cart.add(Item(sku="C", name="C", price_cents=3005, qty=1))
    cart.apply_coupon("SAVE10")
    receipt = cart.receipt()
    # nets 900,1800,2705 sum 5405; tax (5405*8+50)//100 = 432
    # floors: 432*900//5405=71 rem5045, 432*1800//5405=143 rem4685, 432*2705//5405=216 rem1080
    # 71+143+216=430 leftover 2 to first two lines
    assert [ln.tax_cents for ln in receipt.lines] == [72, 144, 216]  # 71+1, 143+1, 216
    assert receipt.total_cents == 5837  # 5405 + 0 + 432 = 5837


def test_issue_discount_tie_earlier():
    """Leftover discount cents go to largest remainder, ties to earlier line."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="A", name="A", price_cents=5, qty=1))
    cart.add(Item(sku="B", name="B", price_cents=5, qty=1))
    cart.apply_coupon("SAVE10")
    receipt = cart.receipt()
    # subtotal 5+5=10; discount 10*10//100=1
    # floors: 1*5//10=0 rem5 each, tie so earlier line wins
    assert [ln.discount_cents for ln in receipt.lines] == [1, 0]  # 0+1, 0


def test_issue_tax_tie_earlier():
    """Leftover tax cents go to largest remainder, ties to earlier line."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="A", name="A", price_cents=5, qty=1))
    cart.add(Item(sku="B", name="B", price_cents=5, qty=1))
    receipt = cart.receipt()
    # subtotal 5+5=10; discount 0; nets 5,5; tax (10*8+50)//100=1
    # floors: 1*5//10=0 rem5 each, tie so earlier line wins
    assert [ln.tax_cents for ln in receipt.lines] == [1, 0]  # 0+1, 0


def test_issue_lines_in_cart_order():
    """Receipt lines are in cart order."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="Z", name="Zed", price_cents=300, qty=1))
    cart.add(Item(sku="A", name="Ay", price_cents=100, qty=1))
    cart.add(Item(sku="M", name="Em", price_cents=200, qty=1))
    receipt = cart.receipt()
    assert [ln.sku for ln in receipt.lines] == ["Z", "A", "M"]  # insertion order


def test_issue_totals_match_cart():
    """Receipt totals equal the cart subtotal, discount, shipping, tax and total."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="A", name="A", price_cents=2000, qty=2))
    cart.add(Item(sku="B", name="B", price_cents=1500, qty=1))
    cart.apply_coupon("FIVEOFF")
    receipt = cart.receipt()
    # subtotal 2000*2+1500=5500; discount 500; discounted 5500-500=5000; shipping 0; tax 5000*8//100=400; total 5000+0+400=5400
    assert receipt.subtotal_cents == 5500  # 4000+1500 = 5500
    assert receipt.subtotal_cents == cart.subtotal_cents()  # equals cart
    assert receipt.discount_cents == 500  # fixed 500, min 2000 met
    assert receipt.discount_cents == cart.discount_cents()  # equals cart
    assert receipt.shipping_cents == 0  # 5000 >= 5000 free
    assert receipt.shipping_cents == cart.shipping_cents()  # equals cart
    assert receipt.tax_cents == 400  # (5000*8+50)//100 = 400
    assert receipt.tax_cents == cart.tax_cents()  # equals cart
    assert receipt.total_cents == 5400  # 5500-500+0+400 = 5400
    assert receipt.total_cents == cart.total_cents()  # equals cart


def test_issue_fixed_discount_split():
    """Fixed coupon discount splits proportionally and sums exactly to cart discount."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="A", name="A", price_cents=1000, qty=1))
    cart.add(Item(sku="B", name="B", price_cents=2000, qty=1))
    cart.add(Item(sku="C", name="C", price_cents=3000, qty=1))
    cart.apply_coupon("TENOFF")
    receipt = cart.receipt()
    # subtotal 1000+2000+3000=6000; discount min(1000,6000)=1000
    # floors: 1000*1000//6000=166 rem4000, 1000*2000//6000=333 rem2000, 1000*3000//6000=500 rem0
    # 166+333+500=999 leftover 1 to first line
    assert [ln.discount_cents for ln in receipt.lines] == [167, 333, 500]  # 166+1, 333, 500
    assert sum(ln.discount_cents for ln in receipt.lines) == 1000  # equals cart discount
    assert receipt.discount_cents == 1000  # min(1000,6000) = 1000


def test_contract_subtotal():
    """Subtotal is the sum of price_cents times qty over every line."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="A", name="A", price_cents=250, qty=2))
    cart.add(Item(sku="B", name="B", price_cents=100, qty=3))
    assert cart.subtotal_cents() == 800  # 250*2=500 plus 100*3=300 is 800


def test_contract_second_coupon():
    """At most one coupon may be applied; a second raises CouponError."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="A", name="A", price_cents=1000, qty=1))
    cart.apply_coupon("SAVE10")
    with pytest.raises(CouponError):
        cart.apply_coupon("HALFOFF")


def test_contract_shipping_threshold():
    """Shipping is free at $50 discounted subtotal else $5.99, empty has none."""
    empty = Cart()
    assert empty.shipping_cents() == 0  # empty cart has no charge
    low = Cart()
    low.add(Item(sku="L", name="L", price_cents=4999, qty=1))
    assert low.shipping_cents() == 599  # 4999 < 5000 so 599
    high = Cart()
    high.add(Item(sku="H", name="H", price_cents=5000, qty=1))
    assert high.shipping_cents() == 0  # 5000 >= 5000 free


def test_contract_tax_half_up():
    """Tax is 8% of discounted subtotal rounded half up."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="A", name="A", price_cents=7, qty=1))
    assert cart.tax_cents() == 1  # (7*8+50)//100 = 106//100 = 1
